text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having finished the contest, the two 
praise each other for a well-fought 
battle. Hishi Amazon tells Biko Pegasus 
that she's an Umamusume who fires everyone 
up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Those words struck a chord with Biko 
Pegasus, giving her a clear picture of her 
ideal hero: someone that makes everyone 
say, "I want to be just like them!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that goal in sight, Biko Pegasus sets 
her eyes on becoming the undisputed 
champion of the sprint division. 
Meanwhile, Hishi Akebono finds herself 
wishing she could be just like her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus had two goals: to win both 
the Sprinters Stakes and the Mile 
Championship.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As a prelude to the main event, Biko 
Pegasus took on the Centaur Stakes in 
early autumn.
